capabilities: Render .cook recipe files with ingredients, cookware, and timers highlighted
Read YAML frontmatter metadata such as title, servings, and prep time
Display ingredients with inline quantities and checkboxes
Number steps in the directions section
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to preview or nicely render Cooklang recipe files stored in a vault.
summary: Recipe preview plugin that renders Cooklang .cook files with highlighted ingredients, cookware, timers, and numbered directions.
